fields.label: Default Model
fields.description: Used when a chat does not pick another model from the catalog.

fields.label: Default Thinking Effort
fields.description: Used when a chat does not pick another effort.

fields.label: Available Models
fields.description: Model IDs this provider offers. Fetch models reads the catalog from the provider API; the default model must be one of them.

fields.label: Model Efforts
fields.description: JSON map of model ID to what the provider API reported for it: supported thinking efforts and, when known, the output token ceiling.

fields.label: Base Url
fields.description: Custom kind only: the allowlisted https endpoint; built-in kinds use fixed endpoints.

fields.label: Is Shared
fields.description: Shared providers are usable by every Intelligence user and editable only by managers.

fields.label: Allowed Roles
fields.description: Roles that may use a shared provider, one per line; blank allows every Intelligence user.

fields.label: Max Output Tokens
fields.description: Upper bound on the tokens the model may generate in a single reply (128 to 1048576).

fields.label: Timeout
fields.description: Provider request budget in seconds (5 to 120).
